title: Worker Job Execution Contract
summary: Execute tenant-isolated retriable and scheduled jobs with idempotency and DLQ without owning business action authority.

criteria: The Job, Task and Schedule triple is human-approved as the closed execution shape before any implementation begins, with Job carrying tenant_id, job_type, task_name, payload and idempotency_key.
job_type is fixed to the declared workload set ai_enrichment|sync|media|export|analytics, so a caller cannot invent a new class of background work at runtime.
The Job state set is fixed as queued|running|succeeded|failed|dead with attempt/max_attempts and run_after driving every transition.
idempotency_key semantics are fixed so a duplicate submission never produces a second effect, and a Job is never deleted once it reaches dead.
The exclusion set is explicit: no business action authority, no business rule/computation ownership, no saga/BPMN workflow orchestration and no Event Bus replacement.

risks.desc: A Job processed without its tenant_id scope would let one tenant's payload be enriched, exported or synced into another tenant's data.
risks.mitigation: Require tenant_id on every Job and a tenant-scoped queue and rate-limit, with cross-tenant submission and read negatives before human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: At-least-once delivery without idempotency_key deduplication would double-charge, double-export or double-post on every retry.
risks.mitigation: Fix idempotency_key semantics and outbox same commit enqueue, and prove a repeated key yields no second effect before implementation.

risks.desc: Dropping an exhausted Job instead of routing it to the dead-letter queue would lose work silently with no operator signal.
risks.mitigation: Require dead-letter routing where a Job is never deleted, plus explicit audited DLQ replay and a visibility_timeout_s re-delivery path.

risks.desc: A job execution primitive could be misread as authority to decide business actions, own computation rules or replace the Event Bus and workflow engine.
risks.mitigation: Keep no business action authority, no business rule/computation ownership, no saga/BPMN workflow orchestration and no Event Bus replacement explicit, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The execution shape is the closed triple Job, Task and Schedule: a Job carries tenant_id, job_type, task_name, payload and idempotency_key, a Task names the unit of work and a Schedule expresses cron/interval recurrence.
job_type is limited to ai_enrichment|sync|media|export|analytics, and the Job state set is exactly queued|running|succeeded|failed|dead driven by attempt/max_attempts and run_after.
retry applies exponential backoff with jitter; once max_attempts is exhausted the Job moves to the dead-letter queue and is never deleted, and DLQ replay stays an explicit audited action.
circuit breaker, visibility_timeout_s re-delivery and overlap_policy keep a stalled or overlapping run from corrupting the queue.
A tenant-scoped queue and rate-limit bounds noisy-neighbor pressure ve bu birim business action authority üstlenmez.

Kapsa: Job/Task/Schedule shape with tenant_id, job_type, task_name, payload and idempotency_key; the ai_enrichment|sync|media|export|analytics workload set; queued|running|succeeded|failed|dead states with attempt/max_attempts and run_after; retry with exponential backoff and jitter; dead-letter with audited DLQ replay; circuit breaker, visibility_timeout_s and overlap_policy; tenant-scoped queue and rate-limit. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Every Job carries tenant_id and runs behind a tenant-scoped queue and rate-limit, so a missing tenant context rejects the submission instead of widening it.
A worker executes a Task under the submitter's scoped authority and never elevates itself; business action authority stays with the calling domain.
ai_cost_scope bounds AI-driven job spend per tenant and a kill-switch can halt a job_type without deleting queued work or losing dead-letter history.
payload contents are treated as sensitive: they are never logged verbatim, and an immutable audit records each state transition and every DLQ replay.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one Job dispatcher keyed by job_type instead of per-workload queues and bespoke retry code, with a short-code bütçe sınırı and katman separation.
Backoff, jitter and run_after computation stay pure and deterministic so a retry schedule can be asserted without a live broker.
Queue and reliability standards are referenced through standardRefs rather than restated inside this contract.
codeOptimization.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: single job_type dispatcher, deterministic backoff computation, referenced standards. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: Boundary validation allowlists job_type and task_name before a Job is accepted; an unknown workload class is refused rather than queued for later triage.
Least-privilege separates submission, execution and DLQ replay: a submitter cannot replay the dead-letter queue and a worker cannot rewrite its own attempt counter.
Immutable audit records each queued|running|succeeded|failed|dead transition together with the actor who triggered a replay or a kill-switch.
securityOptimization.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: job_type allowlist, submission/execution/replay separation, immutable transition audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: Queue depth and wait time targets must be declared per job_type with an explicit p95 budget, since an ai_enrichment Job and an analytics Job have very different acceptable latencies; no measurement is claimed here.
visibility_timeout_s must exceed the realistic execution time of its Task so a slow run is not re-delivered while still healthy.
Performance evidence must cover noisy-neighbor containment, dead-letter growth under sustained failure and N+1 avoidance during job payload hydration before any readiness claim.
performance.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: per-job_type queue depth and latency targets, visibility_timeout_s sizing, noisy-neighbor and DLQ growth evidence. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobile or web caller submits a Job and receives an acknowledgement, never a synchronous result; forcing synchronous request-response into the queue is not permitted.
A client polls or subscribes for the queued|running|succeeded|failed|dead state, tolerates offline gaps, and must treat a repeated submission with the same idempotency_key as the same Job.
No mobile monitoring surface is introduced; presenting job state stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: asynchronous submission acknowledgement, client state polling with idempotency_key, no monitoring surface here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future operations console must expose job state and attempt/max_attempts as accessible text rather than by color-coded badge alone.
A long-running Job must expose progress through an aria live region without stealing focus, stay keyboard reachable with a visible focus ring and meet the AAA contrast threshold.
Because this contract renders nothing, all accessibility outcomes stay planned and none may be recorded as met at this node.
wcag.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: accessible job state text, non-intrusive progress announcement, nothing rendered here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Docker/Kubernetes worker pool, broker and scheduler topology remains human-developer work.
A future deployment must drain queued work before replacing a worker, since a Job in the dead-letter queue is never deleted and must survive a rollout.
Undoing this shard touches only the planning contract and its deterministic projections; runtimeDataImpact stays none and the verdict stays NO-GO.
deployment.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, drain-before-replace rollout expectation, bounded undo. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: This contract is execution plumbing, not decision automation: a Job transition may emit a planned event but no ruleset decides business outcomes here.
saga/BPMN workflow orchestration stays outside this scope; chaining Jobs into a business process belongs to the workflow authority.
Automation may record a planned approval request but cannot replay the dead-letter queue, disable a circuit breaker or claim successful runtime execution.
eca.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: transition events only, workflow orchestration excluded, no automated DLQ replay or breaker override. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: AI may read the execution contract and suggest a changeset, but submitting a Job, replaying the dead-letter queue, raising max_attempts and bypassing tenant scope are forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
Any activation or implementation waits on explicit insan onayı; an AI lane holds no auto-apply route, no admin override and no delegated-admin standing over the queue.
AI-driven enrichment work stays inside ai_cost_scope, and neither prompt text nor repository content may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or manufacture executed-test evidence.
aiAgents.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, forbidden job submission and DLQ replay, ai_cost_scope containment, mandatory human approval. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases run each job_type in ai_enrichment|sync|media|export|analytics through queued|running|succeeded and through the failed path to dead, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove exponential backoff with jitter, attempt/max_attempts exhaustion into the dead-letter queue and that a dead Job is never deleted.
Planned negatives prove a duplicate idempotency_key has no second effect, that enqueue and its originating write share the outbox same commit, and that DLQ replay is explicit and audited.
Planned negatives cover circuit breaker opening, visibility_timeout_s expiry re-delivery, overlap_policy on a cron/interval Schedule and kill-switch behaviour.
Planned tenant isolation negatives exercise cross-tenant Job access and noisy-neighbor pressure against the tenant-scoped queue and rate-limit.
testing.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: per-job_type state progression, backoff and DLQ negatives, idempotency and outbox proof, breaker/timeout/overlap/kill-switch cases, tenant isolation and noisy-neighbor negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by scoping every Job to tenant_id, applying payload validation at submission and refusing worker self-elevation beyond the submitter's authority.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled through idempotency_key deduplication, dead-letter durability and circuit breaker containment instead of unbounded retry.
OWASP A09 security logging and monitoring failure is modeled by requiring an immutable audit of every state transition, DLQ replay and kill-switch action.
owasp.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 tenant scoping and no self-elevation, A04 idempotency and bounded retry design, A09 immutable transition auditing. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-agent-runtime with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-tenancy, k-authz, k-bus] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
Each publicBoundary flag stays false, so a job submitter reaches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor event-bus-delivery-contract ends 2026-09-10, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly event-bus-delivery-contract and k-tenancy and does not inherit the parent-only k-authz, k-bus, k-sequence, scale-invariant and k-boyut1-ops-panel edges.
Scope stays inside the execution layer: no business action authority, no business rule/computation ownership, no saga/BPMN workflow orchestration and no Event Bus replacement.
integration.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-agent-runtime, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module submits a Job with its tenant_id and idempotency_key and cannot run its own thread or cron in place of this primitive.
A consumer must tolerate at-least-once delivery and make its Task effect idempotent rather than assuming exactly-once execution.
Deciding whether a business action should happen at all remains the calling domain's authority, never the worker's.
moduleUsage.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: consumer job submission, at-least-once tolerance and idempotent task effects, business decision authority excluded. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A Job payload may carry PII, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
Dead-letter entries are never deleted by the worker itself, so their retention window and disposal path need an explicit human-approved policy.
Completed Job records and their payloads are purged on a declared tenant-scoped schedule; no long-term business data store is created by this node.
dataLifecycle.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: payload personal-data classification, dead-letter retention policy, tenant-scoped purge of completed jobs, no store created here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include queue depth and wait time by job_type, retry rate, dead-letter arrival rate, circuit breaker open time and kill-switch activations on tenant-safe labels.
Logs and traces carry job id, job_type, attempt and tenant scope with payload redaction; idempotency_key and payload contents are never metric labels.
Alerts cover a dead-letter growth spike, a stuck running Job past visibility_timeout_s, a noisy-neighbor rate-limit breach and an ai_cost_scope overrun; thresholds require human approval.
observability.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: queue depth and retry SLIs, redacted job labels, dead-letter and stuck-job alerts, ai_cost_scope overrun. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is a downstream outage during a Task; it degrades to retry with exponential backoff, then a circuit breaker, then the dead-letter queue, never to silent success.
Delivery is at-least-once, so the same Job and idempotency_key must always converge on the same effect regardless of how many attempts occur.
A worker restart or redeploy re-delivers an in-flight Job after visibility_timeout_s rather than losing it, and dead-letter history survives the rollout.
reliability.notes: worker-job-execution-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Worker Job Execution Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: graded degradation from retry to breaker to dead-letter, at-least-once convergence, restart re-delivery and history survival. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
